about: How the opening made each value dev mode's "How this world opened" shows (src/bench/dev-views/opening.ts). From the opening audit of Nov 16, 2026: every seeded draw and table read a New Game world takes, recorded by line at Loudon NH, St. Louis MO and Cambridge MN (the Account lead's report opening-draws-and-fixed-values, in the project's shared folder). Rows say how each value shown was made; sites say how each line of code that draws at the opening draws, keyed by file and function, as src/core2/kernel/draw-recorder.ts records them. dev-opening-draws.test.ts records a pinned opening and fails on a site not listed here. A row or site changes in the same pull request that changes how the opening makes its value.

kinds.world-offset: World offset from a published figure
kinds.ad-hoc-draw: Drawn with no record behind it
kinds.constant: Fixed number, same in every world

labels.title: How this world opened
labels.recording: Rebuilding this world from its recipe and recording every draw (several minutes; a big town takes longer)
labels.notRecorded: Not recorded yet: press Record to rebuild this world's opening and list every draw it takes.
